description: This source file defines a script for analyzing extension plugin SDK boundary violations within a code repository. It scans source files, classifies import/export paths, and generates inventory reports comparing actual vs. expected plugin boundary rules.

methods.name: collectExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects source code files from the extension root directory, filtering out test files and non-code files.

methods.name: collectParsedExtensionSourceFiles
methods.description: Reads and parses collected extension source files into TypeScript sourceFile objects.

methods.name: resolveExtensionRoot
methods.description: Determines the extension root based on a file's path relative to the repository root.

methods.name: classifyReason
methods.description: Provides a human-readable reason string for why a specific import or export path is classified under a certain boundary rule.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting inventory entries.

methods.name: shouldReport
methods.description: Determines whether an import or export path should be reported based on mode and path.

methods.name: collectEntriesByModeFromSourceFile
methods.description: Analyzes a source file to collect boundary entries categorized by mode.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Generates inventory of SDK boundary violations for a specified mode, with caching for performance.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory from a JSON file, handling missing files gracefully.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory of boundary violations into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check, outputs results in JSON or human-readable format, compares with baseline, and reports differences.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the boundary check script process.
